record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare DEFENSE_CURL: Bronzor (1 star) and Bronzong (2 stars); both range 1, maxPP 80, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the buff table and speed (36 for both).
record.summary: Needs no target. The caster raises its own Defense and Special Defense by the same raw amount, 5 (1 star) / 10 (2 stars), each scaled by AP (apBoost 1) and by crit power if the cast crit (crit only rolled with the ABILITY_CRIT effect), plus a Big Eater Belt x1.25 (rounded down) when held; then its attack cooldown is reset to round(250 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) ms. The buffs persist for the rest of the fight in the code read (no expiry present in this strategy).

targeting.note: process receives target null and only touches pokemon (the caster).

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by addDefense: round(requested x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1)); then Big Eater Belt: x1.25 rounded down if the caster holds it (value > 0); Twist Band does nothing for a positive self-buff; def = max(0, def + applied).
effects.resolution: requested (raw table) -> applied (after AP, crit, belt) -> new def value (clamped at 0; irrelevant for a positive buff).

effects.scaling: same as Defense: round(requested x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1)), Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down, Twist Band no effect; speDef = max(0, speDef + applied). The same crit flag is used for both stats.
cooldown = round(250 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) with the caster's current speed (36 for both units at base: about 250/0.652 = 383 ms before any speed change).

starBehavior.note: table index is the casting entity's stars; 20 and 40 are not reached at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state; each cast adds the buff again (stacking, no cap other than the >= 0 floor) and resets the cooldown again.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 5 / 10 to Def and SpeDef (1 / 2 stars). Requested = raw; applied = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor) then x1.25 rounded down with Big Eater Belt. Twist Band has no effect on this positive self-buff. Both stats receive the same applied amount (same helper chain, same flags).
